nodes.name: AMMC-B1 neuron
nodes.type: antennal mechanosensory and motor center B1 projection neuron (= aPN1a,b per VFB synonyms; second-order song-relay neuron)

behavior.text: Courtship-song hearing: the fly detects a mate's pulse song via Johnston's organ auditory neurons and relays it through AMMC to central courtship circuits.
behavior.basis: textbook Drosophila courtship-song pathway (JO-B -> AMMC-B1 -> vPN1 -> pC1); stated as known biology — the API indexes none of these links (see honest_note)

fly_narration: A song in the air — listen.
honest_note: HONEST STUB: the courtship-song relay classes are unindexed in every VFBquery-reachable dataset. AMMC-B1 (FBbt_00110120, the song-relay projection neuron): 0 downstream rows (grouped id+label), named DownstreamClassConnectivity dies server-side, BANC v888 0 rows; 5 FAFB skeletons exist but tracings are ~empty (48 partners / 75 synapses, mostly placeholder neurons). vPN1 (FBbt_00111295, third-order song neuron): 0 downstream, 0 upstream rows. Intrinsic AMMC neuron (FBbt_00111352): 0/0. AVLP_pr01 (FBbt_00052102): 0 downstream. pC1-male (FBbt_00047348): 0 upstream rows; pC1-general upstream gives only generic ontology buckets. P1 (FBbt_00110621): 0 upstream rows. Per-pair probes (AMMC-B1/vPN1/AVLP->pC1, JO-B->AMMC-B1): all 0. See subgraphs/song_lit.json for the literature-grounded hypothesis chain (JO-B -> AMMC-B1 -> vPN1 -> pC1), edges labeled LITERATURE-HYPOTHESIS, none presented as measured wiring.
